evals.prompt: Run an autonomous deep code audit on the local trpc-agent-go repository, identify high-risk Smart Pointer defect slices, and prepare an empirical reproduction test.
assertions: Executes multi-probe static analysis without hanging on stdin
Filters out non-code assets and media (.gif, .png, docs)
Isolates test suite to the specific modified sub-package

evals.prompt: Scout the TencentCloud/CubeSandbox repository for the top 3 maintainer-welcomed deep-water defects and output objective feasibility scores.
assertions: Ranks candidate issues by the 8 deep-water defect archetypes
Disqualifies cosmetic typos and unlinked pull requests

evals.prompt: Complete surgical remediation, collect empirical verification evidence, run governance quality audit, select the pinned public Issue or private security-disclosure route, and submit the pull request.
expected_actions: trusted provider-backed IssueCreationService / IssueBindingArtifact or SecurityDisclosureArtifact
assertions: Enforces RFC-100 line limit and anti-AI linter
Binds the provider-verified public Issue route or the authorized private security route before opening the Pull Request
Uses the canonical route and passes markdown bodies safely through local files
